class multifit.input.ModelConfig(module, function: str, number_of_peaks: int, spectrum_params: list[str], peak_params: list[str], kwargs: dict)

Bases: object

Class for configuration of the model

The model consists of a cumulative density function describing a single peak structure. The function may be repeated to model several peak structures. Each function parameter may be shared by all peaks in a spectrum or all instances of a peak across spectra.

module

Path to the python module where the model function is defined.

Type:

path

function

Name of the function defining the model.

Type:

str

number_of_peaks

Number of peak structures to model for each spectrum.

Type:

int

spectrum_params

Name of parameters to be shared by all peaks in a spectrum.

Type:

list of str

peak_params

Name of parameters to be shared by all instances of the same peak across spectra.

Type:

list of str

kwargs

Additional keyword arguments required by the function.

Type:

dict

multifit.input.fetch_data(config: DataConfig, cls, sorting_key=0, npy=True) → list[Spectrum | CoincidenceMatrix]

Read data files.

WARNING: This function will be depracated in the future.

Parameters:

  • config (DataConfig) – Data configuration object.

  • cls ({Spectrum, CoincidenceMatrix}) – Class to read the data into.

  • sorting_key – key to use when sorting the data object list. May be a constant or a callable taking the file name as a positional argument.

  • npy (bool) – If true, try to read the data from a .npy file. If such a file doesn’t exist, generate it. (default True)

Returns:

Sorted list of data objects read from each file.

Return type:

list of cls

classmethod from_config(config: ModelConfig) → Self

Build a class instance from a ModelConfig instance.

make_cdf(*, peak_number: int, spectrum_number: int) → callable

Return the cdf with the proper signature.

Define a function to be used by iminuit.cost.ExtendedBinnedNLL, with a signature ensuring the correct sharing of parameters.

Parameters:

  • peak_number (int) – number identifying a specific peak. Peaks with the same peak_number will share peak_params.

  • spectrum_number (int) – number identifying a specific spectrum. Peaks with the same spectrum number will share spectrum_params.

Returns:

Cumulative distribution function with parameter names specifying peak and spectrum numbers.

Return type:

callable

sum_cdfs(spectrum_number) → callable

Sum the cdfs for all peaks in a spectrum to a single cdf.

match_param(string, peak_numbers, spectrum_numbers) → list[str]

List parameters matching string given peak and spectrum numbers.

Parameters:

  • string – On the form <name> or <name>_<peak>_<spectrum>, where <peak> and <spectrum> can be numbers or wildcard ‘*’. The input <name> is equivalent to <name>_*_*.

  • peak_numbers – numbers of the peaks against which string is matched.

  • spectrum_numbers – numbers of the spectra against which string is matched.

Returns:

A list of valid parameter names to the function returned by make_cdf for each combination of peak and spectrum number.

Return type:

list[str]

expand_and_list(string) → list

Expand a parameter name as a list [name, peak, spectrum].

Parameters:

string (str) – On the form <name> or <name>_<peak>_<spectrum>, where <peak> and <spectrum> can be numbers or the wildcard *. The input <name> is equivalent to <name>_*_*.

Returns:

A list corresponding to the input string, as [name: str, peak: int | slice(None), spectrum: int | slice(None)]

Return type:

list
